title: Turkey Taco Spaghetti
ingredients: TO SERVE: soured cream, jalapeños, coriander leaves, lime wedges
method: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan (400°F), Gas Mark 6.
Spray an ovenproof dish with oil and stir together the onion, garlic, turkey mince, chopped tomatoes, tomato purée, hot stock, spaghetti and all the spices and salt. Mix well.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil, stir, then top with the grated cheese and return to the oven (without foil) for 10 minutes until the cheese is bubbling.
Serve with soured cream, jalapeños, coriander and lime wedges.
notes: Use lean minced beef or chicken mince instead of turkey. To make it vegetarian, replace mince with a can of black beans and use vegetable stock.
